profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Target
profile.summary: Software Engineer with demonstrated work history within retail, information technology, and services industry. Skilled in business, data, and system analytics. Bachelor of Science in Computer Science earned at Metropolitan State University in St. Paul, MN.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microservices · Apache Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · Kotlin · Micronaut · Next.js · Spring Boot · Java · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microservices · Apache Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · Kotlin · Micronaut · Next.js · Spring Boot · Java · React.js

positions.title: Analyst, Business Technology Operations
positions.description:
-Maintain field & retail partners/users relation for feedback on current systems, measuring pain points and successes within internal systems
-Data reporting on statistical information within internal systems to identify issues to fix or suggest enhancements to implement
-Analyze data and make suggestions/recommendations that will impact financial growth and enhance partner/user experience
-Analyze data and make suggestions/recommendations that could potentially impact savings for operating costs
-Facilitate deployment and integration of enhancements and redesigns of internal systems
-Ensure system usability on new hardware upgrades and ensure it's compatibility
-Work and collaborate with stakeholders, business partners, and users to align technology with business objectives

positions.title: Repair Technician
positions.description:
-Diagnose and repair client devices
-Maintain client contact with repair statuses for proper communication and transparency to achieve good customer service
-Research complex technology issues and provide repair solutions
-Educate fellow Agents on common issues and known bugs/defects along with repair solutions
-Document detailed repair notes for client transparency
-Windows, Mac OS, iOS, and Android subject matter expert

positions.title: Personal Banker
positions.description:
-Maintained client relations
-Provide banking and lending solutions to match client needs
-Managed financial portfolios for client needs
-Ensured security of financial and personal property
